author: rewrite_termination
scope: Canonical reworking of the two existing L008 and N016 principal contracts, with no new source, question or compression credit.

science.common: Explicit orbit normalization, chamber reconstruction and reflection, relation kernels, local mirrors and prime-degree minimality.
science.L008: Full Theorem 1.1, preserving the geometry hypothesis and both directions without assuming the designated group is already the full automorphism group. Infinite chamber sets are allowed.
science.N016: All proved conclusions of the acquired eight-page author edition, with general embedded-kernel criterion, all stated corollaries, both infinite-family applications and the complete six-group example.
science.questions: Already admitted unrestricted, finite rank-four and interval conclusions are documented separately; their proofs are not premises. The all-rank finite multiplicity problem remains unresolved.

programs.old_driver_execution: Archived complete, not executed; current portable runner uses the unchanged GAP file directly.

formal.limits: Actual two-copy group formulas are checked. Geometry, the polytope correspondence, family classification and source-specific GAP groups remain written, retained or computational as identified.

render: All four fresh PDFs have identical per-page extracted text to the bound PDFs, no missing glyphs or overflow warnings, and full nonspace program inclusion. PDF byte differences from fresh rendering reflect nondeterministic metadata and are not treated as byte identity.
resolved_authoring_failures: First replay needed Lean source copies under the fresh working directory for the compiler root check; the final runner performs this explicitly.
Second replay exposed discretionary verbatim continuation symbols in PDF extraction; the renderer now disables those symbols rather than stripping program text. The final full replay passed.
attribution: The common organization and explicit map are not claimed as historically novel. Source conclusions, standard correspondence and retained outside classifications have point-of-use attribution.
publication: Private only. No public files modified. No measurement or ratio calculated.
